completed: Preserved runnable incumbent strategy/engine and early-scanner source alongside the isolated 52-configuration workbench.
Verified 50 target integration tests and 357 isolated workbench tests; original strategy functions and synthetic weight matrices match.
Verified one status-only Slack receipt and the new guarded scheduler; the old KeepAlive service is disabled.
Evaluated eight frozen new factor/control configurations: one base-only joint pass, zero base-plus-stress passes; all 60 configurations remain disclosed.
Evaluated six separately registered covariance/diversification and trend hypotheses; no joint primary pass among 66 completed configurations.
Evaluated six implementation-stability and fixed-mixture configurations; two pass the latest primary goals in both windows and both base/stress scenarios. All 72 configurations remain disclosed.

Independent equity and metric audit confirms all 20 new configurations and 162 original/additional paths. The growth/gold plus minimum-variance ensemble has base Sharpe 1.187/1.105 and stress Sharpe 1.137/1.016.
The ensemble still has approximately 20% drawdown; 50bp costs and some rolling windows fail. No selection-adjusted alpha, independent forward result or live trading authority is claimed.

Evaluated all six preregistered aggregate-risk and actual-holdings controls across72 independently audited paths. All78 configurations remain disclosed; two new variants retain the primary base/stress goal but none meets the frozen upgrade contract.
The observed-weight band reduces five-year order tickets167 to94 and raises stressed Sharpe1.0160 to1.0417, but50bp Sharpe0.9957 and about5% turnover reduction still fail the upgrade criteria.
Volatility controls reduce some drawdowns to about18% but increase turnover and fail five-year stress. The incumbent, prior results and old paused forward ledgers remain unchanged.
For the user's lower-risk request, preregistered six unleveraged portfolios using actual momentum/value/quality/low-volatility ETFs;84 total configurations, no results yet for the new lane.

An explicit pre-result data-quality revision excludes27 early zero-volume VLUE warmup bars; formal10y/5y windows and all candidate rules stay unchanged, with reduced rolling-window coverage disclosed.
completed_zh: 已保留可运行的原Top30算法、成本引擎和独立早期扫描器，并隔离导入52配置研究工作台。
目标整合50项测试及独立研究357项测试通过；原算法函数与五组完整合成权重矩阵保持等价。
已验证一条仅状态Slack回执及新定时任务；旧常驻心跳服务已停用，未改变持仓或Discord任务。
已评估8个冻结新因子及对照：基础情景联合通过1个，基础及压力联合通过0个；累计60个配置全部保留。
已评估第二轮6个协方差分散及趋势假设，无联合通过；累计完成66个配置。
第三轮6个配置评估完成，2个通过最新两项目标的双窗口基础及压力门槛；全部72个配置保留，尚未满足旧回撤上限。
独立账本与指标复算确认20个新配置及162条原始/追加路径；成长黄金与最小方差组合基础Sharpe为1.187/1.105，压力为1.137/1.016。
组合回撤仍约20%；50bp成本及部分滚动窗口失败，尚无经多重选择修正的alpha或独立前瞻证明，不产生实盘权限。
已完成6个预注册风险及调仓对照、72条独立记账路径；累计78个配置全部披露，2个保留原基础及压力门槛，但0个满足预设升级标准。
实际持仓交易带将五年订单从167笔减至94笔、压力Sharpe从1.0160升至1.0417；50bp时仍为0.9957，金额换手仅降约5%，未达升级条件。
波动率控制把部分回撤降至约18%，但增加换手并未通过五年压力门槛；原策略、历史结果和暂停前瞻记录保持不变。
针对降低风险的要求，已预注册6个无杠杆动量/价值/质量/低波动ETF组合，累计登记84个；新研究尚未出结果，不混称个股基本面选股。
业绩计算前发现VLUE早期27条零成交量记录，已保留证据并修订预热起点；正式双窗口及策略不变，滚动覆盖减少如实披露。
next: Obtain provenance-checked factor ETF history and evaluate true dependence,15%drawdown, lower volatility, and unchanged Sharpe/SPY goals without declaring correlated funds independent.
Seek verifiable historical execution or publication-time fundamental data for new hypotheses; do not retune the near-threshold band on the same exposed history.
Keep candidate rules frozen and obtain genuinely new timestamped forward observations before any trading promotion; do not backfill or restart paused ledgers implicitly.
Retain higher-cost and rolling-window failures as open robustness limitations, not hidden exceptions or reasons to rewrite frozen evidence.
Publish only date-aligned, timestamped and hash-verified watch evidence; never relabel old signals.
Compare identical windows, costs and Sharpe definitions before comparing strategies.
Preregister bounded hypotheses and preserve failures and the paused forward record.
next_zh: 核验新因子ETF历史并评估相关性、15%回撤及波动改善；Sharpe与SPY目标不放宽，不把四只相关基金称为四份独立收益。
下一类假设先补可核实的历史执行数据或带披露时间的基本面证据，不在同一已见历史上微调接近门槛的交易带。
保持候选规则冻结；交易升级前需要真实新增、可证明时点的前瞻观察，不补造数据或隐式重启暂停记录。
保留更高成本及滚动窗口失败作为未解决的稳健性限制，不隐藏例外或重写冻结证据。
先取得同一截止日、可证明首次可得时间并通过来源哈希校验的观察输入，不改写旧信号日期。
使用相同窗口、成本与Sharpe定义比较策略，再讨论优化，不混用不同策略的历史业绩。
预注册有界研究假设，保留失败结果和暂停的前瞻记录；不回填、不自动调参。
